description.narrative: The proposed transaction is an up to EUR 17.0m participation in a convertible instrument of up to EUR 22.0m in favour of the North Symphony Investments S.a.R.L, (the "Investee") alongside majority shareholder MidEuropa Partners Fund V ("MEP") and selected minority shareholders for EUR 5.0m. EBRD's investment would consist of a EUR 15.0m committed tranche and a EUR 2.0m uncommitted tranche. The Investee is a holding company based in Luxemburg and the 100%-owner of UAB Pigu (the "Company"; "PHH Group" together with subsidiaries), a Lithuania-based provider of e-commerce services with operations across the Baltics and Finland. Project objectives include: - Increase in the number of merchants from the Baltics on the Company's platform - Bolstering of the Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) generated by Baltic merchants on the Finnish marketplace - Profitability improvements
